title: RealNVP coupling as a nonlinear functional view
hypothesis: A task code inside an affine coupling rule yields nonlinear input-dependent behavior beyond linear activation steering, while preserving exact invertibility/logdet and using fewer bytes than independent task flows; compare with an equally sized noninvertible MLP intervention.
physical_object: shared 2D affine coupling map with a frozen conditioner form
mirror_coordinate: one scalar task code modulating affine scale and translation

development.selection_metric: heldout transform nRMSE, inverse-cycle error, logdet/Jacobian determinant, actual bytes, MACs

fresh.reason: synthetic coupling-function screen; exact native RealNVP alias assessed before any audit

compute.counts: MACs and exponentials reported separately; logdet is recorded

success_gate: Flow heldout nRMSE <=0.02, max cycle error <=1e-5, finite positive determinant for all evaluated samples, >=25% fewer bytes than independent flows, and strict functional/byte/compute improvement over linear and equal-size MLP controls.
failure_gate: Quality/storage/compute gate miss or exact native RealNVP function/payload alias is FAIL for Mirror-specific value.
boundaries: Analytic 2D synthetic coupling family; no trained RealNVP density model or downstream behavior benchmark.
The MLP comparator is trained on 12 task codes and tested on four unseen codes; the coupling teacher is generated by the same family.
No higher-dimensional flow, likelihood benchmark or accelerator runtime claim.
